status: prospective procedure frozen; acquisition requires a separate complete immutable source/layout binding

candidate.source: the clean tested native-record-alias product commit, never PR977 or an experiment branch runtime

rules: Exact package-member delta, not a minimum list.
Unchanged dependency lock, fixture lock, native WASM/assets, codec settings, workers and grouping policy.
All ordinary browser harness/dependency bytes identical between baseline and candidate.
Build both release Chrome packages before acquisition; keep source/package guards before and after all phases.
No product overlays, no variant experiment flags, no PR977 runtime composition.

readiness: Full required JavaScript lint, main/test TypeScript, complete unit inventory, all build targets and new focused ownership/lifecycle/route tests pass on exact candidate.

Actual natural-offset 170-group VNDB A/B replay uses the real three-worker receiver, real importer private callback and production source planner, actual canonical dedup, content compression and record/index stores.

Natural replay preserves every source row/key/score/sequence/definition and all original canonical identities; verify physical relocation, every alias, all prepared lookup payloads, store drainage and exact file inventories.
A standalone alias-specific comparator passes adversarial unit cases before any ordinary timing acquisition.
All unmeasured browser layout preflights pass and are bound before warmups/timed pairs. A failed preflight is a validation/source issue, never a timing result.

naturalReplayExpectedActivation.note: These fixed expectations must be verified before acquisition. Any mismatch stops and requires source/design review; do not infer activation solely from elapsed time.

browserLayoutPreflight.appliesTo: VNDB, one A and one B full import per independent host before its ordinary warmups
browserLayoutPreflight.order: the host's assigned initial AB or BA order
browserLayoutPreflight.commandBoundary: Existing benchmark + all-media validation, with an identical source-bound test-only hook that runs after the existing timed interval and restart checks. Product package is untouched. All automatic timings in this phase are retained and excluded.
browserLayoutPreflight.hook: A unique checked source replacement invokes an external verifier immediately after report.benchmark.validation has been populated and before quick-mode return/context cleanup. The original/overlay hashes and exact replacement are retained; restore original harness and prove it clean before ordinary acquisition.

export.io: Read-only OPFS File snapshots exported in fixed <=256 KiB chunks via Playwright, incrementally written and SHA256-hashed by Node. Check exact offsets, lengths, base64 round trips, expected file sizes and final hashes; never materialize a complete large file in the browser or in one CDP message.
proof: Run the unchanged production reader/decoder on the exported browser files and compare every logical row against the frozen natural-replay oracle.

Enumerate every new alias envelope/reference. Each must be in the prospectively recorded group and decode byte-for-byte to its original canonical raw-v6 definition; verify all175 affected row references.
Verify the entire original canonical content stream is preserved through the explicit relocation map, rather than broadly ignoring content bytes.

Verify all unaffected lookup payloads retain their expected native bytes; the eight promoted groups retain their complete original native prepared payloads. Decode all lookup/record rows, key/sequence postings, score/length values and ID ordering.

Canonical metadata must preserve IDs, hashes, logical lengths, dictionary families, dedup counts and original canonical targets after physical relocation; no canonical entry may be promoted to a new record-only alias.

Retain the raw pre/post-restart probe structures in this preflight and recompute the original physical probe digest plus a separate offset-independent semantic projection. Prove all intentional physical differences; do not replace the original digest silently.

Acquire and close an exclusive sync-access handle for each term file in an untimed dedicated test worker after reads settle, to prove no import writer lease survives. The verifier performs no writes/truncation and joins/terminates its worker. Existing SQLite runtime handles are outside this term-writer lease assertion.
Inventory before/after export and handle checks must be identical. Unexpected files, changed sizes during snapshotting, parser/import errors or cleanup warnings fail the preflight.
export.unrelatedStorage: Retain the complete normalized inventory and all available raw hashes. Media bytes and all-media digest remain exact. Stock SQLite SAH inventory/allocation checks remain exact (prospective current bound37 units), and unrelated semantic rows/metadata remain exact. Raw SQLite hashes contain permitted runtime metadata and are retained without claiming cross-run byte identity; no new normalization is allowed.

browserLayoutPreflight.bindings: The verified five term-file hashes/sizes and physical probe digest become an immutable per-arm host witness before ordinary acquisition. Browser exports must match the natural replay's exact deterministic term files or the discrepancy stops preflight. No post-timing witness changes.

comparator.stockPerObservationValidator: Call unchanged validate_import_summary with exact source/package/browser/fixture hashes, full strict success, no fallback, fresh profile and production defaults. Only the declared preflight/memory test harness overlays set source_dirty=true with the exact overlay hash; ordinary observations remain clean.
comparator.withinArm: Use unchanged require_matching_receipts for all ordinary observations within A/C and within B, including exact normalized file sizes and the original physical outputDigestSha256; the preflight anchors each arm. Keep every raw receipt.
comparator.crossArmNonTargets: JMdict and Jitendex use the unchanged exact comparator across A/B/C; candidate alias count and input bytes must both be zero.
crossArmVndb: Require exact browser/fixture/options/title/revision/row counts, complete cold/warm termsFind results and all72 lookup hashes, media verification and every semantic field.

The only intentional cross-arm receipt differences are the five enumerated term-file byte sizes/total and the original physical probe digest. Each value must equal its frozen verified arm witness; never delete unknown fields or accept a free-form tolerance.

The separate full browser-file proof replaces cross-arm equality of those physical fields: all alias envelopes, complete affected records, complete decoded row/lookup semantics and canonical/dedup invariants must pass.
Every non-enumerated normalized storage path and size, including media and SQLite allocation, remains exact. Reject additions/removals/reclassification and sum total bytes from the exact inventory.

Require actual candidate activation counts8/2983 and baseline absence-or-zero under the frozen baseline schema. Require unchanged parser/source grouping and all logical dedup/canonical counters; physical write/lookup chunk counters may differ only as predicted by the complete replay witness.

alias points to wrong canonical definition

ordinaryAcquisition.hostBoundary: Six distinct fresh hosted job VMs; preserve host/browser/Node identities and never pool across hosts/orders. Exactly Node22.22.0, pinned Playwright Chromium binary, strict headless and no headed/storage fallback.
ordinaryAcquisition.perHostSchedule: Two excluded warmup pairs in initial then opposite order. Twelve measured A/B pairs alternate initial/opposite order. After pairs3,6,9,12 insert one unchanged A/C control pair, alternating AC/CA with the initial-order offset. Thus24 candidate observations +8 controls +4 excluded warmups per host.
ordinaryAcquisition.timing: Unchanged page file-input-change to post-UI import-complete monotonic endpoint. Fresh browser profile each observation, one complete pinned corpus, no phase tracing, screenshots, process sampling or hooks during ordinary acquisition.
ordinaryAcquisition.media: Sampled media checks in every ordinary observation, followed by independent all-media A and B imports. No timing from exhaustive-media imports enters statistics.
ordinaryAcquisition.sourcePolicy: No retries, replacements, exclusions, extra blocks, trimmed tails or adapted flags. Stop on first failed required observation and preserve every attempted result.

statistics.resampling: 10000 complete-pair bootstrap draws with random.Random(897); resample paired indices jointly for millisecond differences and percent ratios, report sorted indices249 and9749 as descriptive95% bounds. Keep all raw pair vectors. No population-general confidence claim.

vndbAdvanceEachHost.controls: Both |median paired C/A percent| and |equal-work C/A percent| must be strictly less than half the smaller absolute candidate median-paired/equal-work percent saving.

nonTargetEachHost.controls: Both absolute median paired and equal-work C/A changes must be <=1%.

statistics.globalDecision: Both VNDB hosts and all four non-target cells must pass every semantic/source/memory gate. Any incomplete cohort, contrary equal-work result or failed control condition is inconclusive/hold regardless of a favorable statistic. A qualified timing pass may support a PR claim limited to these exact corpora/source/hosts; no pooling with d0 component results or PR977.

memory.sequence: After all ordinary and all-media observations, unchanged four-observation ABBA/BAAB instrumented memory schedule per host.
memory.gates: Keep all existing process-tree PSS/private-byte coverage/scan-gap requirements, every observation qualified, median paired increase <=5%, maximum paired increase <=10% for both metrics. No observer-gap waiver.
memory.interpretation: Separate diagnostic memory screen, no timing contribution and no process-peak savings claim from operation counts.

reporting: Always print source bindings, every raw ordinary duration/control, per-arm physical witness digest, semantic/alias counts, memory qualification and all failure phase tails to job logs.

Retain original summary/raw report/probe/export/witness data and the complete source/command manifests. Pack binary trees containing native '|' filenames into archives before upload; upload archives plus safe-name JSON/logs only.

Retain all failed attempts. A packaging repair must not rerun unchanged timing acquisition to replace missing artifacts. Final review requires auditable retained raw evidence, not only a passing stdout summary.
